command:
set -euo pipefail
VIS=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
BR=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo
CAND_BRANCH=chatgpt-vps-work/frank-avatar-go-blink-identity-fix-20260912
CAND_COMMIT=e8d09af9b3fb3df9020ee3956111f3ba99a1ce5d
EXPECTED_DAEMON=5527a1510e4101bcd97a9f57317580638757485d929a9b8e68c3d0ea9d91fcd2
EXPECTED_HTML=18770d8e333af1bc49a818da4dbd5c2e482b859e0142d0213df6c956184c931e
EXPECTED_FILM=179f49a31514c02048891ba7f49a1cc7c241c691eaf9a684a4f40094f487d66b
cd "$VIS"
echo HOST=$(hostname)
test "$(hostname)" = ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein
test "$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_DAEMON"
test "$(sha256sum buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_HTML"
test "$(sha256sum filmlook.js | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_FILM"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service)" = active
TMP=$(mktemp -d /var/tmp/go-avatar-blink-rebind-XXXXXX)
BACKUP="$VIS/.go_backups/blink-pre-rebind-20260912T0721"
mkdir -p "$VIS/.go_backups"
test ! -e "$BACKUP"
mkdir "$BACKUP"
rollback(){ echo 'ROLLBACK=1'; cp -a "$BACKUP"/blink_*.png "$VIS/augen_blink/"; WIN=$(DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool search --name 'FranKenstein -- live' | head -1 || true); test -z "$WIN" || DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool key --window "$WIN" ctrl+shift+r || true; }
trap 'rc=$?; rollback; rm -rf "$TMP"; exit $rc' ERR
cp -a "$VIS"/augen_blink/blink_*.png "$BACKUP/"
echo OLD_BLINK_SET=$(sha256sum "$VIS"/augen_blink/blink_*.png | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
git -C "$BR" fetch --quiet origin "$CAND_BRANCH"
test "$(git -C "$BR" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$CAND_COMMIT"
git -C "$BR" show "$CAND_COMMIT:handoff/frank-avatar-round2-candidate/build_blink_eye_local_mask.py" > "$TMP/build.py"
python3 "$TMP/build.py" "$VIS" "$TMP/out" > "$TMP/report.stdout"
python3 - "$TMP/out/report.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
fs=d['frames']
assert len(fs)==12
assert all(0 < float(x['alpha_nonzero_frac']) < 0.25 for x in fs)
assert all(float(x['alpha_opaque_frac']) < 0.15 for x in fs)
print('CANDIDATE_FRAMES',len(fs),'ALPHA_NONZERO_MAX',max(float(x['alpha_nonzero_frac']) for x in fs))
PY
cp -a "$TMP"/out/blink_*.png "$VIS/augen_blink/"
echo NEW_BLINK_SET=$(sha256sum "$VIS"/augen_blink/blink_*.png | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
for f in "$TMP"/out/blink_*.png; do n=$(basename "$f"); localh=$(sha256sum "$f"|awk '{print $1}'); liveh=$(curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:8788/augen_blink/$n" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'); test "$localh" = "$liveh"; done
WIN=$(DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool search --name 'FranKenstein -- live' | head -1)
test -n "$WIN"
DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool key --window "$WIN" ctrl+shift+r
sleep 3
# deterministic user-equivalent blink trigger; successful render is captured from the real window
DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority xdotool key --window "$WIN" b
sleep 0.16
DISPLAY=:0 XAUTHORITY=/home/ai-core-node/.Xauthority import -window "$WIN" "$TMP/blink-live.png"
identify "$TMP/blink-live.png"
echo BLINK_CAPTURE_SHA=$(sha256sum "$TMP/blink-live.png" | awk '{print $1}')
python3 - "$TMP/blink-live.png" <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np,sys
a=np.asarray(Image.open(sys.argv[1]).convert('RGB'))
l=a.mean(axis=2)
print('CAPTURE_SIZE',a.shape[1],a.shape[0],'BLACK_FRAC',round(float((l<5).mean()),6),'WHITE_FRAC',round(float((l>250).mean()),6))
assert (l<5).mean()<0.95 and (l>250).mean()<0.95
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,time,urllib.request,statistics
xs=[]
for i in range(10):
 with urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8788/api/status',timeout=3) as r: d=json.load(r)
 f=(d.get('fps') or {}).get('fps'); print('FPS',i,f)
 if isinstance(f,(int,float)): xs.append(float(f))
 time.sleep(1)
med=statistics.median(xs) if xs else 0
print('FPS_N',len(xs),'FPS_MEDIAN',med,'FPS_MIN',min(xs) if xs else None)
assert len(xs)>=8 and med>=58
PY
test "$(sha256sum buehne_daemon.py | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_DAEMON"
test "$(sha256sum buehne.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_HTML"
test "$(sha256sum filmlook.js | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED_FILM"
echo BLINK_REBOUND_LIVE_ASSET_PROMOTION_PASS=1
trap - ERR
rm -rf "$TMP"
